AllowlistItem.title: AllowlistItem
AllowlistItem.description: Authorized email record for gated portfolio access with global or single-resource clearance

authorized.description: Whether the email is authorized to access gated artifacts

role.description: Access tier granted to the user

scope.description: Whether the clearance is global or restricted to specific articles/resources

allowedItems.description: Specific article and resource IDs that this user is explicitly permitted to access

allowedSections.description: Specific sections (e.g. case-studies, publications, archives) permitted

addedBy.description: Email or identifier of the administrative authorizer

SecurityLocks.title: SecurityLocks
SecurityLocks.description: Granular lock status configuration for sections and individual articles/resources

lockedSections.description: Sections currently locked (e.g., case-studies, publications, archives)

lockedItems.description: Specific individual article and resource IDs explicitly locked

unlockedItems.description: Specific individual article IDs explicitly unlocked even if parent section is locked

updatedBy.description: Email of admin who updated lock configuration

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the lock configuration update

PageStats.title: PageStats
PageStats.description: Analytics for each page, including read counts (stars)

pageId.description: Unique identifier for the page or section

stars.description: Number of stars/reads recorded for this page

lastUpdated.description: Last time a star was added

DenyListEntry.title: DenyListEntry
DenyListEntry.description: Dynamic blacklist entry blocking specific intrusive individuals or IPs from accessing the portal

value.description: Blocked IP address or email identifier

/allowlist/{email}.description: Collection storing allowlisted user emails with granted roles and granular resource clearance

/security_settings/{settingId}.description: Configuration document storing section-level and item-level lock settings

/page_stats/{pageId}.description: Collection storing stars/read counts for each section

/denylist/{entryId}.description: Dynamic deny list for real-time blocking of intrusive IPs and individuals
